gates.delegated_share: measured analytic remote FLOP fraction (remote fwd+bwd / total fwd+bwd, per the validated instrumentation) >= 0.15
gates.privacy: for each qualified attack family x channel, the cell's worst per-seed advantage <= 0.02; families: token-inversion (P0), sequence-property-v2, structure-semantic-v2 (P4b); channels: forward latents AND returned (inbound) gradients; gradient-channel variants qualify on fresh calibration captures with the same frozen floors (property r-advantage >= 0.10, structure >= 0.02, token-inversion 0.05; |null| <= 0.02); a channel-variant that fails qualification is DISQUALIFIED and named
gates.utility: mean Delta_U = L(trained) - L(all_local) <= 0.10 nats with the upper 95% CI <= 0.12

confirmatory_rule.missing_data: at most one retry per run with identical cell identity; a seed is dropped from affected tests only (predeclared, never outcome-based)
confirmatory_rule.pairing: per-seed paired contrast within block pb-p5-{seed}
confirmatory_rule.triangle_note: an empirical feasible-set statement within this mechanism family, not a universal law
